title: nf-core/proteinfamilies pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

id.errorMessage: Sample id must be provided and can only contain letters, digits, dots, underscores and dashes

fasta.errorMessage: Fasta file for amino acid sequences must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', '.fasta', '.faa', '.fas', '.fa.gz', '.fasta.gz', '.faa.gz' or '.fas.gz'

existing_hmms.errorMessage: Existing family HMMs must be a '.tar.gz' archive without spaces in its path
existing_hmms.description: Gzipped tarball of existing family HMMs, one file per family named after its HMM NAME. A sample with this column goes through the update path. Example: 'existing_hmms.tar.gz'

existing_seed_msas.errorMessage: Existing seed MSAs must be a '.tar.gz' archive without spaces in its path, and need 'existing_hmms'
existing_seed_msas.description: Gzipped tarball of existing family seed MSAs (aligned FASTA, as this pipeline writes them; passed through unchanged unless the family is rebuilt), each named after its family's HMM file (same file name stem; not every HMM needs one). Requires 'existing_hmms'. Example: 'existing_seed_msas.tar.gz'

existing_full_msas.errorMessage: Existing full MSAs must be a '.tar.gz' archive without spaces in its path, and need 'existing_hmms'
existing_full_msas.description: Gzipped tarball of existing family full MSAs (aligned FASTA, as this pipeline writes them, or Stockholm), each named after its family's HMM file (same file name stem; not every HMM needs one). Their members are pooled with the input sequences and searched again with the existing HMMs; members without hits are dropped and never create new families. Requires 'existing_hmms'. Example: 'existing_full_msas.tar.gz'
